About Vicki

Your Advocate
From Contract to Keys


I'm Vicki Wong, a licensed realtor at eXp Realty serving families and investors across the East Bay and South Bay. As an alumni of UCLA in Anthropology, my work has always bridged logic and emotion — helping people navigate complex decisions with clarity and confidence.

What sets me apart is my background in Data Analytics combined with deep community roots. I understand the numbers that drive smart decisions, and I understand the family priorities that go beyond any spreadsheet. Whether you're buying your first home in Castro Valley or selling a luxury property in Cupertino, Palo Alto, or Saratoga, I bring the same level of care and precision to every transaction.

As a trilingual agent (English · 廣東話 · 普通話), I'm proud to serve the Bay Area's vibrant Cantonese and Mandarin-speaking communities, making sure nothing is ever lost in translation — especially when the stakes are high.

I was featured in the Silicon Valley Business Journal for high-end Bay Area listing strategy, and ranked #1 on my team for highest-priced buyer transaction in 2024.

What I Offer

Buying, Selling & Investing

Buyer Representation

From first-time homebuyers to seasoned investors, I guide you through every step — property search, offer strategy, inspections, and closing — with clear communication in your preferred language.

📈
Seller Strategy

Strategic pricing, professional marketing, and deep local market knowledge. My goal is to get your home sold quickly and at the best possible price. Featured in the Silicon Valley Business Journal for high-end listing strategy.

💼
Investment Properties

My data analytics background gives clients a unique advantage when evaluating investment opportunities across Fremont, San Jose, Hayward, and beyond. I analyze the math so your decisions are backed by evidence.
